defaultOpen.name: Default Open
defaultOpen.description: Whether the popover is open by default (uncontrolled).

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: The name of the component that triggered the popover, reflected as the data-trigger attribute.

placement.name: Placement
placement.description: The placement of the popover relative to the trigger.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: The additional offset applied along the main axis between the element and its anchor element.

crossOffset.name: Cross Offset
crossOffset.description: The additional offset applied along the cross axis.

isNonModal.name: Non Modal
isNonModal.description: Whether the popover is non-modal, i.e. elements outside the popover may be interacted with.

isDismissable.name: Dismissable
isDismissable.description: Whether the popover can be dismissed by clicking outside it.

isKeyboardDismissDisabled.name: Keyboard Dismiss Disabled
isKeyboardDismissDisabled.description: Whether pressing the Escape key to close the popover is disabled.

shouldFlip.name: Should Flip
shouldFlip.description: Whether the popover should flip its orientation when there is insufficient room.

isEntering.name: Is Entering
isEntering.description: Whether the popover is currently performing an entry animation.

isExiting.name: Is Exiting
isExiting.description: Whether the popover is currently performing an exit animation.
